risks.risk: Wheels may be bent or have bearing play (no spin/straightness check in photo).

risks.risk: Tires may be worn or have dry rot; punctures may be present (tread depth not measurable from this image).
risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread and sidewalls, and a quick pump/pressure check or test ride over a short distance.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires may need replacement soon.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as folding parts may need tightening/repair.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the drivetrain (chain, cassette/freewheel, derailleur) and shifters.
Send a close-up of the brakes (front and rear) and brake pads/rotor/drum area.
Send a short ride video showing: braking hard, shifting through all gears, and straight-line tracking.
Send a close-up of the folding hinge/lock points showing they are tight (no wobble).
Send a photo of any readable brand/model/serial plate (if present on the frame).
